anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: LXX 23:8-10: the Lord mighty in war; the Lord of powers; king of glory.
Reconciling a world to himself, not counting trespasses.
Having wiped out the handwriting against us, contrary to us; taken it from the midst.
The Father glorified in the Son — possible.

pass_a_gloss: And a second time having been heard to powers standing by, and they examining who it is, they heard: Lord mighty and powerful in war, Lord of powers, this is the king of the glory — for king of fatherly glory, in which a Father is glorified, having reconciled a world to himself, not having reckoned to it the false-steps, but having wiped out the against-it handwriting which was contrary, and he has taken it out of the midst.
pass_b_english: And when it was heard a second time by the powers standing by, and they were examining who it is, they heard: "The Lord, mighty and powerful in war, the Lord of powers, this is the king of glory" — for king of the Father's glory, in which the Father is glorified, having reconciled a world to himself, not counting its trespasses against it, but having wiped out the handwriting against it, which was contrary, and he has taken it out of the midst.
source_text: Καὶ δεύτερον ἀκουσθέντος ἐφεστώσαις δυνάμεσιν, καὶ ἀντεξεταζουσῶν τὸ τίς ἐστιν, ἤκουσαν· "Κ(ύριο)ς κραταιὸς καὶ δυνατὸς ἐν πολέμῳ, Κ(ύριο)ς τῶν δυνάμεων, οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς δόξης", βασιλεὺς γὰρ δόξης πατρώας, ἐν ᾗ δοξάζεται π(ατ)ὴρ καταλλάξας ἑαυτῷ κόσμον, μὴ λογισάμενος αὐτῷ τὰ παραπτώματα, ἀλλὰ ἐξαλείψας τὸ κατ’ αὐτοῦ χειρόγραφον, ὃ ἦν ὑπεναντίον, καὶ ἦρκεν αὐτὸ ἐκ μέσου.
